title: Tonight on the Titanic
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie visit the famous ship on its very first — and last — voyage. 杰克和安妮登上了那艘著名巨轮的处女航，也是最后一夜。🚢

q.en: What time did the great ship hit the iceberg?
q.zh: 这艘巨轮是在几点撞上冰山的？

options.zh: 下午3点15分，发生在很久很久以前

explain.en: The ship struck the iceberg at 11:40 in the evening, just before midnight.
explain.zh: 巨轮在晚上11点40分、临近午夜时撞上了冰山。

q.en: How many lifeboats were on the ship?
q.zh: 这艘船上一共有多少艘救生艇？

explain.en: The great ship carried only twenty lifeboats, though it needed twice as many.
explain.zh: 这艘大船只有二十艘救生艇，其实需要两倍之多。

q.en: Why did the closest ship not come to help after the SOS call?
q.zh: 发出求救信号后，为什么最近的船没有赶来救援？

options.en: It was too far away to hear
options.zh: 它离得太远，听不到信号

options.en: Its radio had been turned off
It sailed the other way on purpose
It was already full of people

explain.en: The nearby ship's wireless had been switched off, so it never heard the call for help.
explain.zh: 附近那艘船的无线电被关掉了，所以没有收到求救信号。

q.en: Who were William and Lucy on the ship?
q.zh: 船上的威廉和露西是什么人？

options.en: The ship's captain and his wife

explain.en: William and Lucy were young brother and sister traveling on the ship.
explain.zh: 威廉和露西是船上的一对年幼兄妹。

q.en: What did Lucy give Jack and Annie as the special gift?
q.zh: 露西把什么作为特别的礼物送给了杰克和安妮？

explain.en: Lucy gave Jack and Annie her father's silver pocket watch as the gift from the lost ship.
explain.zh: 露西把父亲的那块银怀表送给了杰克和安妮，作为来自沉船的礼物。

q.en: What time had Lucy's pocket watch stopped?
q.zh: 露西的怀表停在了几点？

explain.en: Lucy's watch had stopped at 2:20, the time the ship went down.
explain.zh: 露西的怀表停在了2点20分，正是大船沉没的时刻。

q.en: What kind of animal was Teddy?

explain.en: Teddy was a small terrier puppy who was under a magic spell.
explain.zh: 泰迪是一只中了魔法的小猎犬。

q.en: Who were allowed into the lifeboats first?
q.zh: 谁被允许最先登上救生艇？

explain.en: On the sinking ship, women and children were allowed into the lifeboats first.
explain.zh: 在正在下沉的船上，妇女和儿童被允许最先登上救生艇。

q.en: Which gift did Morgan ask for that matched the Titanic?
q.zh: 摩根要的四个礼物中，哪一个对应的是泰坦尼克号？

options.zh: 遥远的森林，发生在很久很久以前

explain.en: Morgan's note asked for a gift from 'a ship lost at sea,' which matched the Titanic.
explain.zh: 摩根的字条上要的是‘一艘沉入大海的船’的礼物，正好对应泰坦尼克号。

q.en: What did the ship's musicians keep doing as it sank?
q.zh: 船下沉时，船上的乐手们一直在做什么？

options.zh: 他们躲进了一艘救生艇

explain.en: The ship's musicians kept playing as the great ship sank.
explain.zh: 船上的乐手们一直演奏音乐，直到大船沉没。
